## Functions

### createShiitakeAcpServer()

```ts
function createShiitakeAcpServer(directory): ShiitakeAcpServer;
```

Host stable ACP over the maintained Streamable HTTP transport.

Each accepted connection gets its own ACP adapter state. The supplied directory
remains the authorization boundary and Shiitake remains the Session/transcript
owner.
